name: IT Helpdesk Overview
description: Metabase dashboard for IT Helpdesk Overview

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hd_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND created_at::date = CURRENT_DATE AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hd_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'OPEN' AND sla_deadline < NOW() AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) as count FROM hd_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND status = 'OPEN' AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY priority
SELECT created_at::date as day, COUNT(*) as count FROM hd_tickets WHERE tenant_id = {{tenant_id}} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
